notes.title: "Pieces of the Abyss: Succubus" has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

"Pieces of the Abyss: Succubus" has been released!
I’m very happy to have taken this big step forward 😁
Your support and encouragement help me grow.

Thank you! 🙏

notes.title: "Pieces of the Abyss: Succubus" is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello, this is GlassCup.

The release date for "Pieces of the Abyss: Succubus" has finally been decided!
This first installment, "Pieces of the Abyss: Succubus", is a casual hentai puzzle game.
We have used generative AI to enhance the quality as much as possible.

We sincerely hope for your support and interest. 😌


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2322580/Pieces_of_the_Abyss__Succubus/
